mainEntity.name: Why does purpose of initial consultation matter at the consultation stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because the first review works best when the objective, the current status, and the available facts are clear from the beginning. Before the next step, purpose of initial consultation usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
